results.title: A service restart between an edit and the save still delivers the save (stateless sessions)
evidence: after restarting the service, the final save reached the consumer true, signed true, holding the edit true

results.title: A consumer that is down (503) or refusing (401) at the final save, then recovered within the retry horizon, receives the save
evidence: consumer answering 503 twice: 3 delivery attempt(s) (503, 503, 200); the third delivered the save true holding the edit true; one deliveryId across attempts true
consumer answering 401 twice: 3 delivery attempt(s) (401, 401, 200); the third delivered the save true holding the edit true; one deliveryId across attempts true

results.title: Conversion refusals on the pinned release: metadata source, source redirect, oversized input, timeout, a source cut part way, unreachable and redirecting upload; the converter stays free
evidence: a metadata source address: 400 {"error":"source_url_refused"} in 0s (want 400 source_url_refused)
a redirect from the source host (not followed): 502 {"error":"source_unavailable"} in 4s (want 502 source_unavailable)
an input over the 5 MB battery cap: 413 {"error":"input_too_large"} in 4s (want 413 input_too_large)
a source that never finishes (20 s battery deadline): 504 {"error":"conversion_timeout"} in 20s (want 504 conversion_timeout)
an unreachable upload address: 502 {"error":"upload_failed"} in 4s (want 502 upload_failed)
a redirect from the upload host (not followed): 502 {"error":"upload_failed"} in 1s (want 502 upload_failed)
a metadata upload address: 400 {"error":"upload_url_refused"} in 0s (want 400 upload_url_refused)
a source that drops part way (ADR F17): 502 {"error":"source_unavailable"} in 10s (want 502 source_unavailable)
a good conversion after all of the above: 200 {"size":55025,"sha256":"6252d3948aad531bae23c101c9a8199d17c3681db92109f60d273131f4778319"} in 1s (want 200 undefined)

the redirecting source was asked by api, api, api and the redirect was not followed (no request reached the metadata address from the scratch network); uploads received: redirect from api, e3b-after.pdf from api (none for the refused or failed sources)
http URLs and private addresses are refused only outside EDITOR_ENV=local; the battery runs local, so those refusals are proven by apps/api strict-routes and route tests
